platform_adaptation.reason: The historical WSL/Windows path is absent on this native Linux host. The installed distro Android platform-tools adb is the bounded native transport; using it avoids treating a platform-specific historical path as an execution blocker.

adb.ADB_LIBUSB: not set; that override belonged to the Windows transport and is not carried onto native Linux

lock.acquire: nonblocking flock held for the complete identity, stage, execution, evidence pull and cleanup interval
lock.child_fd_rule: close lock FD 9 in every adb child

safety.cleanup: trap removes only the unique scoped root and verifies it is absent before releasing the lock

campaign.setup: three fresh runner processes per arm; setup action creates four sessions and performs no inference
campaign.e2e: one fresh process per arm, one first plus five same-session warm complete generations
campaign.physical_proof: one separate context-arm detailed-profile process with one complete generation
campaign.source_unavailable_for_context: source-models directory is deleted and absence verified before any context-arm process
campaign.profiling_separation: profiled proof is excluded from setup and E2E timing summaries
